title: Data Structures & Algorithms in Go
intro: Data structures and algorithms questions in Go test both CS fundamentals and practical knowledge of slices, maps, generics, and the standard library. This module covers Big-O reasoning, slice-backed stacks and queues, singly linked lists, sorting, binary search, two pointers, and hash-map patterns. The lessons make the invariant visible, trace a small input, explain time and space costs, and show the focused Go code behind each operation. Comparisons include setup cost, memory, ordering, and mutation so a learner can choose an approach instead of memorizing one complexity label.
